subject.title: Feature/Fix: Add conservative lineage safety and promotion controls

question: Should CodexBar adopt this four-PR lineage accounting architecture, or address the current fork-overcount problem through the narrower identity and cache fix in https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118?
rationale: Both paths target https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/issues/2037, but they have materially different scope, maintenance cost, rollout behavior, and proof maturity; source review cannot determine the intended permanent accounting architecture.

options.title: Prefer the narrow proven fix
options.body: Land the bounded identity and cache correction first, then require evidence of remaining failures before adopting lineage authority.

options.title: Sponsor the lineage stack
options.body: Confirm the broader architecture, review and merge its dependencies in order, and require exact-head real-corpus promotion and rollback proof before authority can change.

options.title: Keep lineage shadow-only
options.body: Accept analytical discovery and diagnostics while deferring the authoritative selector and promotion surface until longer-term corpus validation is available.

recommendation.title: Prefer the narrow proven fix
recommendation.body: Land the bounded identity and cache correction first, then require evidence of remaining failures before adopting lineage authority.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the best available authority for selecting the permanent accounting model and rollout policy.
